edges.reason: Base constructor assigns the _botProtection argument into the stopTheBots state variable.
Memecoin constructor writes the owner state variable from tx.origin, creating tx.origin based ownership.
Constructor reads tx.origin to determine the privileged owner address.
Constructor grants an unlimited allowance entry keyed by tx.origin for the derived pair.
Constructor stores the pairFor result into the uniPair state variable.
Constructor invokes pairFor to compute the Uniswap pair address.
Constructor writes unlimited allowances for the router and tx.origin in the allowance mapping.
transfer passes msg.sender as the from argument of transferFrom.
transfer delegates the whole operation to transferFrom.
transferFrom is wrapped by the checkBots modifier which executes before the body.
checkBots performs a low-level external call to the stopTheBots contract before the guarded body runs.
The stopTheBots state variable is used as the target of the low-level call.
uniPair is ABI-encoded into the bot protection call payload.
The pre-body external call can reenter transferFrom before balances and allowances are updated.
transferFrom reads msg.sender to validate and decrement the caller allowance.
transferFrom performs unchecked subtraction and addition on balances and allowances.
Unchecked arithmetic mutates the balanceOf state mapping for both parties.
Unchecked arithmetic decrements the allowance state mapping.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key.
delegate relies on a msg.sender == owner require for authorization.
The owner state variable is compared against msg.sender inside delegate.
delegate executes a low-level delegatecall to the supplied address and calldata.
delegatecall executes untrusted code in the contract context, enabling arbitrary state manipulation and reentrancy.
The delegatecall target address derives from the a parameter.
The delegatecall calldata derives from the b parameter.
list authorizes the caller with require(msg.sender == owner).
list performs a low-level external call to stopTheBots in the middle of its state updates.
The stopTheBots state variable is the target of the external call in list.
The external call in list can reenter list or transferFrom while balances are partially updated.
list calls the router addLiquidityETH with msg.value.
The pancakeRouter state variable is the receiver of the addLiquidityETH call.
block.timestamp is used to build the router deadline, making execution time miner-influenceable.
totalSupply is used to compute the owner allocation written into balanceOf.
list writes arbitrary values directly into the balanceOf mapping for the contract and recipients.
The _toWho array drives the bulk balance writes and Transfer events in list.
The _amounts array supplies the values written into balanceOf in list.
The _from parameter feeds the checkBots protection call payload.
The _to parameter feeds the checkBots protection call payload.
The _value parameter feeds the checkBots protection call payload.
The value argument is ABI-encoded into the low-level protection call.
The _to argument is forwarded from transfer into transferFrom.
The _value argument is forwarded from transfer into transferFrom.
The _from argument selects the debited balance and allowance entry.
The _to argument selects the credited balance entry.
The _value argument drives the unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom.
The _spender argument is the allowance key in approve.
The _value argument is the allowance value written in approve.
tokenA is ordered and hashed to derive the pair address.
tokenB is ordered and hashed to derive the pair address.
_numList sets the contract balance and liquidity token amount in list.
The notABot local holds the call success flag required by checkBots.
The isNotBot local holds the raw return data of the protection call.
token0 is the ordered token used in the pair hash.
token1 is the ordered token used in the pair hash.
pair is the local result returned by pairFor.
The loop index i iterates the recipient and amount arrays in list.
